text:
anya: Hey team — proposing a compact onboarding + eval protocol for 'stochastic decode' variants (speculative / two-pass / cache-aware sampling). We keep seeing small quality regressions that only show up in specific temps or seeds. Want a reproducible checklist we can run for every new model+quant combo.

matt: +1. can you sketch the minimal steps?

anya: Minimal idea: 1) deterministic baseline (greedy/beam) on 1k prompts, 2) sample-based runs at T={0.3,0.7,1.0} with 5 seeds each, 3) compute automated metrics and delta vs baseline, 4) human spot-check on top-200 high-delta cases, 5) latency/p50/p95 measured under standard batch sizes and our speculative config.

devon: For step 2, do we do full distribution match (e.g., KL between token probs) or just downstream metrics? KL is noisy for long outputs.

anya: Good point. My suggestion: token-level logprob drift + downstream metric (BLEU/ROUGE/BERTScore where applicable) + calibration (expected token acc at top-k). Use KL only as a secondary diagnostic.

kevin: Also include perplexity on heldout dev set — cheap and catches global shifts. And add a flaky-detection run where we vary context ordering / prompt paraphrases.

lina: For human check, propose a 3-judge forced-choice: baseline vs new variant blind pairwise, report majority winner and agreement. We should flag examples with low agreement for further scrutiny.

anya: I'll write a tiny runner. Draft snippet:```python
# run evals for n seeds and temps
for temp in [0.3,0.7,1.0]:
    for seed in seeds:
        resp = client.generate(model=model, prompt=prompt_batch, temperature=temp, seed=seed, max_tokens=256)
        save(resp)
```

matt: Can we also capture the model's runtime mem profile when using speculative prefetch? Memory spikes are correlated with tail latency.

devon: ops-bot: please attach the standard perf harness config (batch=8, seq=1024) when you run this.

eva-bot: @devon attached: perf-harness/v2 config used in prior runs.

anya: QA checklist I want in the ticket: - reproducible run script + seed list - automated metric diffs with thresholds - human eval plan + sample selection rule (top delta + random) - perf numbers (p50/p95/cold-start) - quantization notes (per-layer bits, int8/fp16) - rollback criteria.

kevin: Threshold suggestions: flag if BERTScore drops >0.02 or p95 latency increases >20%. For BLEU/ROUGE thresholds depend on task class; use relative thresholds.

lina: Also add a safety/undesired-output smoke test: run 500 safety prompts and check for any flagged categories, compare FDR. If >1% new hits, block.

devon: Who will own running this first-pass? I can kick off a run on the 2xA100 test pool if anyone confirms the prompt set.

anya: I will assemble the 1k prompt corpus (mix of user samples, benchmarks, and synthetic paraphrases). @devon please hold pool for 3 hours tomorrow morning.

matt: Sounds good. After first pass we should log examples into the eval dashboard with diffs and attach seeds so we can repro exact failures.

lina: For documentation, add a one-page TL;DR in the onboarding doc that lists the quick pass/fail checks.

anya: I'll open a PR with the runner + checklist. tagging people: @matt @devon @kevin for review. :memo:
